ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query is an evidence-based history explanation requiring synthesis of primary sources and a video clip into a structured paragraph. This draws on summarization, extraction/retrieval, and reasoning skills. Willet leads Lapwing on every relevant internal eval (Summarization 86.4 vs 80.6, Extraction & Retrieval 85.3 vs 79.2) and on public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, Arena-Hard, IFEval), with several gaps exceeding the 2.0-point variance threshold. Neither model's distinctive task-preference notes apply here—there's no sensitive content (Willet's specialty) and the task isn't a tightly-specified retrieval job (Lapwing's preference)—so capability differences dominate, and those favor Willet.
